name: White Swan Hotel
scope: The present White Swan Hotel exterior on Shamian Island, comprising the stepped three-storey riverfront podium, attenuated lodging tower, roof crown and mast, and the raised hotel entrance.
era: Current exterior of the hotel on Shamian Island.

originalReview.notes: The byte-identical photo in Qualla has the photographer’s original PD-self declaration. The right side shows the distinctive White Swan slab, angular white cladding and smaller raised roof mass above the Shamian river path.

review.notes: Started with local media already published by Qualla. Onteien’s river view is the exact creator-released public-domain original. A transferred file with an older unrelated Commons upload under the same title, the interior photos and attribution-required sources were excluded.
